Problem Statement:
Given three integer arrays of sizes P, Q and R, determine if there is a subset-superset relation between any two of the arrays.
input_spec:
The first line contains 3 space separated integers P, Q and R
The next three lines contain P, Q and R space separated integers respectively, denoting the three arrays.
output_spec: Print YES if there is a subset-superset relationship between any two of the array. Print NO otherwise.
